ينتهكوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِكُوا (yantahikū) /jan.ta.hi.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# يُنْتَهَكُوا (yuntahakū) /jun.ta.ha.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
